Accuracy = the final turn's model answer containing the SEAM-A marker. The worker auto-continues an agentic reply to any prompt (measured across 240 requests), so this is not question-answering accuracy; it is reported, not claimed. n = 2.

Estimand seam SEAM-A: the corpus's own 32-'#' run is visible to a 4-chars-per-token estimator, so accuracy could not fail under it; the live run answers a 4-token pointer line carrying its sha256 instead.

BASELINE compaction folds every turn but the last KEEP_LAST+1 into one digest line each (DIGEST_CHARS=240) and never rewrites an emitted message; SYSTEM folds with FORK (FORK_LINES=12). These parameters were chosen in the session, after one offline bug fix, and must travel with the number.

The first live attempt (6 requests, E1 turns 1-4) died when the host reaped a bare '&' child; those are excluded. Spend is 240 kept + 6 discarded = 246 of the 260 bound. One discarded request (E2 turn 1) left a warm prefix, which is why that row shows cached=0 for BASELINE and 1152 for SYSTEM.

The chain hash is this unit's own extendable hash: sha over the root..self list of [node_id, kind] pairs, identical to the construction in resextract.context.nodes (canonical_bytes([[node_id, kind], ...])), but accumulated incrementally so 60 turns cost O(n) instead of O(n^2).
